title: Private ActionJournal helper authority owner

construction.failure: typed status and null owner; named-pipe publication is forbidden

owned_state: shutdown admission and one active store borrow counter

borrowed_boundary.pipe_server: borrows one owner for decoded request application
borrowed_boundary.pipe_io: ProtocolSession and pipe reads/writes remain outside owner lock; a separate monitor may probe transport and publishes only an atomic/event cancellation result
borrowed_boundary.session_secrets: HMAC key and nonce remain ProtocolSession-owned

serialization.lock_scope: store application only; never pipe I/O

lifecycle.startup: recover the complete fixed container before CreateNamedPipeW
lifecycle.shutdown: close admission, wait the mutex-held store application, settle protocol/session and pipe, then owner destruction closes lease
lifecycle.shutdown_failure: atomic admission remains closed; no reuse or new store call
lifecycle.unknown_or_corrupt_state: no owner and no published pipe

residual_gates: remote Windows SDK compile and static analysis
